title: Specialist Puzzle, Sports, Vehicle, Party, Strategy, Social & Stealth Pattern Modules

selection_basis.strict_order: GPR-01 → GPR-03 → GPR-05 → GPR-06 → GPR-07 → GPR-08 → GPR-09 → GPR-10 → GPR-12 → GPR-16
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS-19 and OARC-04 remain independently selected_not_started.

objective: Implement reusable specialist GPR modules and conformance fixtures for puzzles, sports/match possession, Vehicle/Mount play, parties/companions, tactical/strategy state, social/investigation and stealth/detection using the shared GPR-05 operation adapter and canonical owner contracts rather than bespoke game forks.
acceptance: Every specialist module uses one declared common GPR module interface over GPR-05 operations and GPR-03 state.
Puzzle, sports, Vehicle/Mount, party/companion, tactical/strategy, social/investigation and stealth/detection semantics remain explicit module adapters rather than generic fallback guesses.
Vehicle/Mount, Character/party, Combat, World/Scene, social/knowledge and stealth/detection owner truth remains with canonical owner domains.
Specialist module outcomes are bounded GPR-local orchestration/results until explicit owner receipts establish owner mutation.
Unsupported specialist bindings and unavailable owner capabilities fail closed.
Domain-specific conformance fixtures demonstrate reusable shared contracts without bespoke runtime forks.
boundaries: GPR-01, GPR-03 and GPR-05 remain predecessors and are not duplicated.
Specialist modules compose shared operations and owner contracts; they do not become replacement domain engines.
MRCS remains definition authority and later MRCS domains may late-bind.
MRCS and OARC lane state remain independent.
next_action: On a GPR-specific owner Continue, fresh-read GPR-06, published GPR-01/GPR-03/GPR-05 evidence, the GPR family design closure and ops3-lane-state/gpr, then execute the complete bounded specialist-module tranche.
